name: opencode
description: Integration skill for handing off complex coding tasks to the external OpenCode agent.

tools.name: handoff_to_opencode
tools.description: Delegate a complex coding task (multi-file, refactor, search) to the external OpenCode agent. This tool runs the 'opencode run' CLI command and captures its output.

prompt.description: The detailed instructions for the coding task. Include context about the files to modify.

project_path.description: Optional: Absolute path to the directory where OpenCode should execute.

model.description: Optional: Model identifier to pass to OpenCode (e.g., 'anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20240620').
